decisive_items: Incisional biopsy revealed an intraepidermal neoplasm consisting of pagetoid cells
Numerous reactive dendritic HMB-45-positive melanocytes scattered among tumor cells
response.rationale: Pagetoid intraepithelial cells with CK7/EMA positivity in an apocrine axillary site are diagnostic of Extramammary Paget's Disease; the HMB-45-positive cells are background reactive melanocytes rather than the tumor cells.
